meta.source_report: Ad-Creator-QA-Report.md (full history, 5 Mehr -> 23 Aban 1405 / Sep 27 - Nov 14 2026)
meta.notes: Rows merged only with explicit backlinks. Latest QA observation wins. Historical image numbers refer to QA1-3 screenshot numbering; SCRUM ids refer to the Jira mapping printed in the report.

issues.title: Company name = full SEO page title (incl. Persian '؛' ':' separators)
issues.report_root_cause: Title split only on | dash dot; Persian semicolon/colon not separators; domain match Latin-only; SEO titles like 'Gym near me' win when og:site_name missing

issues.title: Industry not detected for Persian/English pages; English-only keyword heuristics
issues.report_root_cause: Keyword lists English-only; ambiguous 'training' flips fitness->education; whole-word match already fixed but no phrase weighting, no Persian keywords

issues.title: Missing B2B industries (construction/manufacturing, IT/network, CCTV/security) and no Other/custom
issues.report_root_cause: Industry taxonomy lacks B2B categories; fallback forces Technology/Software which poisons competitors+insights

issues.title: Empty industry triggers misleading duplicate-brand error
issues.report_root_cause: selected_industry NOT NULL; IntegrityError mapped to 'brand already exists' message

issues.title: Logo/colors/social extraction weak; near-white colors labeled high confidence
issues.report_root_cause: Only og:image/schema logo considered (no favicon/apple-touch-icon/logo-class images); background whites kept as palette

issues.title: Junk services in scan+analysis (EN+FA): durations, section headings, counts, benefits, FAQs, discounts, slogans
issues.report_root_cause: Blocklist is literal example strings from client reports (incl. 'martyrs'); no structural rules (duration-only, 'Our X' headings, N+plural facility counts, benefits/features, question titles, trailing-colon labels, Persian discount/installment/FAQ patterns, Persian digits+%)

issues.title: Country/location canonicalization (Iran, codes, multi-city, Persian commas)
issues.report_root_cause: 'last comma token = country' without a country list; Persian comma '،' unsupported; 'Abu Dhabi'/'GCC' become countries

issues.title: Brand form localization + URL rendering broken in RTL ('/https://...')
issues.report_root_cause: Placeholders/industry list English-only; URL field lacks dir=ltr isolation

issues.title: Slow scan/stuck progress bar on 'Website scan'; no stage timings
issues.report_root_cause: Website scan stage takes 3-4.5min and sub-stages not surfaced; needs server log timing evidence (BLOCKED without server logs)

issues.title: Brand analysis output language not enforced across all analyzers (EN output for fa brands)
issues.report_root_cause: language_instruction only in competitor_analyzer; other analyzers lack output-language directive

issues.title: Target audience inconsistent Overview vs Audience tab; invented 'global'/percentages
issues.report_root_cause: Overview reads stale/fallback audience data instead of the audience tab payload; brand location not passed to audience prompt

issues.title: Competitor search for Iran (gl=us, hl=en, English query, self not excluded by domain)
issues.report_root_cause: geo_codes lacks ir; hl default en; query built in English; self-exclusion only via brand_name substring not domain/subdomain

issues.title: Competitors UI: add-competitor 500, silent Auto-Discover, pending analyses, count mismatches
issues.report_root_cause: Scheme-less URLs crash serializer; analyze-without-data returns confident 'analyzed' output with raw field names

issues.title: Variable names/snake_case/raw JSON leak into user-facing analysis text
issues.report_root_cause: LLM echoes prompt variable names (brand_voice, pricing_visible=false); no output scrubber for snake_case/raw JSON

issues.title: Campaign language/currency not defaulted from brand locale (English+USD for fa/Tehran brands)
issues.report_root_cause: Hard-coded default 'en'/USD with code comment admitting it mirrors backend default

issues.title: Currency/budget-type gaps: IRT labeled rial, TRY missing, no daily budget/duration, no thousand separators
issues.report_root_cause: IRT displayed as 'ریال'; fixed currency list without TRY; formatting helpers not localized

issues.title: Campaign service chips: not pre-selected despite helper text, first click inverts, ' and ' join in fa, English description prefill
issues.report_root_cause: Chips initialized unselected while copy says 'remove unwanted'; join literal ' and '; product description built from English service names

issues.title: Create Campaign silently disabled without reason; hidden brand picker
issues.report_root_cause: Empty-brand message only when API list empty; picker hidden until load

issues.title: Segmentation Country/City parsing: Persian comma, country lists, multi-city, prefill visibility
issues.report_root_cause: Comma-split-last-token-country without country validation; Persian comma unsupported; form fields not prefilled visibly

issues.title: Segmentation timeout raw error, no auto-retry
issues.report_root_cause: Axios timeout surfaced raw; single LLM parse attempt (retry added QA6 — verify persistence)

issues.title: Unselected personas shown in Ad Generation drawer
issues.report_root_cause: personaObjects built from all segments; context_payload.selected_personas never read

issues.title: Platform suitability for Iran (Google/LinkedIn recommended despite sanctions; no local platforms)
issues.report_root_cause: No country-based gating/warning; local platforms not in choices — flagged REQUIRES PRODUCT DECISION for platform list, warning is implementable

issues.title: Budget split inconsistent across pages; unselected platform holds share; sums exceed total; funnel 102%
issues.report_root_cause: budget_share read from recommendation rows normalized over AI's recommended set (incl. unselected LinkedIn) instead of selected platforms; per-persona funnel shares not normalized to <=100; money strings built per-page

issues.title: PPC analyzes non-selected services; ghost cards; '4 of 2' counter; missing per-service amounts
issues.report_root_cause: Empty selection falls back to ALL brand services (line 122); header counter uses analyzed-count over selected-count

issues.title: Ads Strategy: no refine, second platform run silently queued, tCPA/tROAS for new accounts
issues.report_root_cause: No refine endpoint for strategy; concurrent run swallowed; bidding guidance lacks account-maturity rules

issues.title: Ad Generation defaults hard-coded TOFU+Meta+persona1 regardless of strategy
issues.report_root_cause: Defaults not derived from persisted strategy (top platform by share, dominant funnel stage)

issues.title: CTAs English-only in Persian ads (stuck to text tail)
issues.report_root_cause: Fixed English CTA matrix + English examples in prompt; no per-language CTA sets; editor list English-only

issues.title: English contamination + duplication in Persian ad copy (lead word, English opener sentence, repeated headline/CTA)
issues.report_root_cause: English hook templates injected into fa copy; no post-validation removing duplicated headline/CTA inside body or English-first sentences for non-en languages

issues.title: Brand name misspelled/transliterated in copy and refine does not fix it reliably
issues.report_root_cause: Exact canonical brand name not enforced in prompt/validation; refine context loses brand name in some paths

issues.title: Fabricated claims (webinars, uptime %, prices, discounts, fake testimonials) in copy and on images
issues.report_root_cause: Model invents offers/numbers; image prompt forbids some text but numbers/prices not explicitly banned; no grounding against brand offers

issues.title: Platform character limits violated at generation and approval; Google RSA needs 3+ headlines/2 descriptions
issues.report_root_cause: Generation prompt lacks per-platform limits; approval accepts overlimit; Google ads single headline/description

issues.title: Visual/ad association, fake logos, aspect ratios (1.91:1, 9:16) missing, cropped preview, image not beside ad in review
issues.report_root_cause: Aspect-ratio options lack 1.91:1 and 9:16; result card crops; title mismatch; real logo never sent to model

issues.title: Persian text left-aligned/scrambled (missing dir=auto) in AI-output cards
issues.report_root_cause: AI content containers lack dir=auto; page-level LTR only

issues.title: Panel locale: fa choice at login not carried; untranslated labels; Latin digits; mixed numerals
issues.report_root_cause: Locale stored per-view not persisted from login; many hard-coded strings; no numeral localization helper

issues.title: AI Credits frozen during session; '• used' missing number in fa; no cap shown
issues.report_root_cause: Credits only refetch on route change; fa template drops the number; limit not rendered

issues.title: Step counts inconsistent (9/9 vs 8/8 vs 10; review 100% pre-complete; raw gate keys as chips)
issues.report_root_cause: Multiple independent denominators; raw missing-keys chips rendered; review progress computed differently from card

issues.title: Dashboard: hard-coded 'Ada' welcome, wrong charts/cards, broken labels
issues.report_root_cause: Sample data instead of account data; label truncation

issues.title: Logout after refresh (regression watch) + FA-53 second tab login redirect
issues.report_root_cause: sessionStorage token not shared across tabs; refresh deadlock fixed in QA4 — verify persistence + cross-tab

issues.title: Completed campaign opens at wrong step; Complete button still present; card truncation/date format
issues.report_root_cause: Resume routing prefers later step for completed campaigns; card truncates industry from left

issues.title: Content Intelligence prefill: manual-only when brand has manual services (late merge skipped); industry/location now ok; relevance for Iran
issues.report_root_cause: Prefill guard `if (brandServices.trim()) return` stops later full-list merge unless userEdited flag; search uses gl=us/hl=en defaults

issues.title: Content Gaps/Matrix/Brief/Add-to-Campaign quality: 0 gaps for fa, '(+ proven framework)', 2-line briefs, phantom saved insights
issues.report_root_cause: Gap query language mismatch; template suffix appended; brief generator shallow; add-to-campaign not surfaced downstream

issues.title: Full Funnel: personas not auto-loaded, launch disabled without reason, ad counts mismatch, schedule TOFU-only, IRT missing, 9:16 missing
issues.report_root_cause: Brand personas not fetched into form; counts computed per-stage inconsistently; currency/ratio lists duplicated and incomplete

issues.title: Scenario Variants: static generic audiences instead of brand personas; stale 'Loading options…'; validation message sticks
issues.report_root_cause: Audience list hard-coded; selection validation not recomputed

issues.title: AI Hooks: type labels English, all platforms tagged, brand/industry not prefilled, absolute claims
issues.report_root_cause: No brand context injection; platform tagging unconditional

issues.title: Ad Library shows static framework catalog as if user's ads; labels English
issues.report_root_cause: No user-ads tab; catalog-only presentation

issues.title: Settings lacks profile/password/credits; no forgot-password; admin impersonation request
issues.report_root_cause: Scope decision needed: forgot-password email flow; impersonation is security-sensitive (authorization decision)

issues.title: Scheme-less brand URL rejected at analysis step with field-less English error
issues.report_root_cause: Scan normalizes but create serializer requires scheme; error not field-scoped/localized

issues.title: Social profile URLs not validated by platform (instagram link in facebook field accepted)
issues.report_root_cause: No per-platform domain validation; review step hides socials

issues.title: Raw booleans/JSON arrays exposed in analysis UI (Has Strategy: , Media consumption [".."])
issues.report_root_cause: Untyped fields rendered as labels; arrays not chipified

issues.title: Product description contains only half of selected services
issues.report_root_cause: Description built from truncated/first-N service list or English-only names; must include all selected campaign services and survive reload

issues.title: PPC falls back from zero selection to ALL brand services; chips look selected but are not
issues.report_root_cause: Explicit acceptance rule: empty selection must raise a validation error, never implicit-all; FE must visibly select and persist chips

issues.title: Rejected ads still offered in Visual Generation without status label
issues.report_root_cause: No status filter/label on ad selection cards

issues.title: Second browser tab redirects to login (sessionStorage token)
issues.report_root_cause: Token in sessionStorage; needs secure cross-tab strategy (localStorage + refresh rotation or BroadcastChannel)

issues.title: Adding competitor with scheme-less URL: URL dropped, empty analysis labeled 'analyzed'
issues.report_root_cause: URL normalization missing on competitor create; analysis proceeds without site data and reports success

issues.title: User-selected industry silently overwritten by analysis (Retail -> ecommerce)
issues.report_root_cause: Analysis output overwrites brand.selected_industry; must treat user choice as authoritative

issues.title: Social Presence tab duplicates every section 3-4x; raw keys visible
issues.report_root_cause: Same payload rendered under multiple sections without dedupe

issues.title: Funnel Refine ignores explicit user instruction (installment offer)
issues.report_root_cause: Refine regenerates from template without applying instruction to per-stage copy; downstream ads don't inherit

issues.title: Analysis progress stuck on Website scan (timing evidence needed)
issues.report_root_cause: Sub-stage durations not emitted; verify with server logs (BLOCKED: no server log access)

issues.title: RTL rendering of generated Persian content in EN panel; dashboard chart label overlap; mixed +/- and 'used' fragments
issues.report_root_cause: dir=auto missing; chart not mirrored in RTL; bidi punctuation

issues.title: Untranslated label inventory across settings/brand/campaign/segmentation/ppc/funnel/platform/ads/library/intelligence/scenario
issues.report_root_cause: Hard-coded strings

issues.title: Inappropriate tone ('خوش آمدی آدا'), inconsistent terminology (آگهی/تبلیغ, قیف/Funnel), mixed formality
issues.report_root_cause: Glossary missing (RM-32)

issues.title: Dates not Jalali; numerals mixed; panel language not synced across tabs; panel locale does not change generated content language
issues.report_root_cause: No Jalali formatter; no cross-tab sync; content language tied to brand not panel (by design) but unexplained

issues.title: Marketing validity: budget on branded keywords, negative keywords missing, PPC lacks volumes/CPC, funnel CTA/KPI templates mismatched to business model (Buy Now/ROAS for B2B lead-gen)
issues.report_root_cause: Strategy templates not parameterized by business model; no negative-keyword generation; no account-maturity bidding ladder

issues.title: Login page fake stats (2,140 brands, 1.2M ads)
issues.report_root_cause: Hard-coded marketing numbers

issues.title: Instagram/social strategy for Iranian audience fully English incl. hashtags; health claims for furniture; FOMO vs cautious audience
issues.report_root_cause: Social strategy generator ignores brand language/market and audience caution

issues.title: Google ad groups contain bare generic keywords ('راحتی','اقساط') causing wasted spend
issues.report_root_cause: Keyword generation lacks product-anchoring rule

issues.title: Historical regressions to re-verify: step4->platform (img17), resume step (img24), approve persistence, ads strategy save (img23), review images (img28), tour highlight/dismiss (img30/7), platform labels leak (img18/19), campaign card (img29)
issues.report_root_cause: Fixed in QA4-6 per reports; retest required on current build
